title: Which path fits the request?
prompt: Place each request on the path built for it.

pairs.item: Search is slow for everyone this morning. You want to know if Glean already knows.
pairs.why: Check the Glean status page for known issues before you open a ticket.

pairs.item: An admin who is not a Designated Support Contact has a how-to question about a setting.
pairs.why: Conversations are open to all users and are the best starting point for most requests.

pairs.item: A Designated Support Contact confirms a connector sync bug that affects many users.
pairs.why: Tickets are best for bug reports and outages that need follow-up and a documented resolution.

pairs.item: A customer wants a new capability that the product does not have today.
pairs.why: Submit feature requests and product feedback on the Feedback and Ideas board in Gleaniverse.

takeaway: Not sure which to use? Start with a conversation. Support can convert it into a ticket.
